name: Commandes
sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM marts.fact_orders

name: Chiffre d'affaires encaisse (EUR)
sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) AS paid_revenue FROM marts.fact_payments WHERE status='succeeded'

name: Ventes par jour
sql: SELECT * FROM marts.daily_sales ORDER BY sales_date

name: Produits vendus
sql: SELECT * FROM marts.product_sales ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC

name: Statut des paiements
sql: SELECT status,count(*) AS payments,sum(amount) AS amount FROM marts.fact_payments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

name: Features clients (30 jours)
sql: SELECT * FROM marts.customer_features ORDER BY customer_id
